function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clocks or real‑time data.  
If you’re looking for the current time in New York, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s world‑clock feature, or simply look at the time on a device set to the “Eastern Time” zone (which is UTC‑5 during standard time and UTC‑4 when daylight‑saving time is in effect).

But we can't guarantee DST. We could say "I don't have real-time capability." But maybe we can use an external API? Not allowed. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time info. But we can give approximate time zone: Eastern Time (UTC-5 or -4). But we can't know if DST currently. We can mention that it's either 5 or 4 hours behind UTC.
